findings.title: Quitting during import leaves the entire batch running
findings.suggested_fix: Give window close and OnBeforeQuit a dedicated shutdown request path. For an active cancellable job, remember the close request, cancel jobCancel, and finish closing after that job settles; for a non-cancellable save, remember the request and wait for it to settle. Preserve the existing dirty-review save/discard/cancel handling before closing, and keep Service.Close responsible for waiting for native work and closing storage. Add a focused test that requests quit during the first file of a batch, verifies later files never start, and verifies the pending quit resumes after cleanup.

Headless UI and native integration tests do not exercise the panel-granted access in the installed bundle.
